purpose: decode END MM2S S2MM GEMM commands using bank_config_pkg capabilities and emit per-module-port ownership

instruction.dma_offset_rule: MM2S and S2MM require local_offset[31:23]==0 before narrowing to the 23-bit engine boundary
instruction.gemm_address_rule: axi_address must be zero; compute receives bank identities only and the output bank native base is implicit word zero

public_interface.base: all fixed public ports and widths of cmd_dispatcher_template v2
gemm_request: m_ctrl_sa_out_base_addr[31:0] tied to zero for compatibility

protocol: strict in-order current-PC ready-valid issue with outstanding nonconflicting DMA and one GEMM; request and response effects occur only on valid-and-ready; responses are backpressured while ISSUE_COMMAND preserves an offered request; END drains

dma_response_policy.identity: existing status tag is the bank identity and must match a pending direction-local bank
dma_response_policy.success: error=0 and error_code=00; matching pending clears and the exact bank owner releases
dma_response_policy.descriptor_error: error=1 and error_code in 01..06; matching pending clears, exact bank owner releases, and dispatcher error-drains with that code
dma_response_policy.transport_or_recovery_fault: error=1 and error_code in 10,20,30,40,50; pending and ownership are retained, no release pulse is emitted, and reset is required for recovery
dma_response_policy.fail_closed: unknown codes or inconsistent error/code qualification retain pending and ownership and report the nonzero code, or FF when error=1 with code=00

failure: unsupported capability, MM2S/S2MM upper local-offset bits, or nonzero GEMM axi_address is an operand error before executor valid and before ownership acquire

required: GEMM nonzero-address reject and zero compatibility output
descriptor codes 01 through 06 retire and release
transport codes 10 20 30 40 50 retain pending and ownership without release until reset
